mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_channel_create_receipts(tenant_id,request_id,actor_ref,request_fingerprint) VALUES(#{tenant},CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid),#{actor},#{fingerprint}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_channel_create_receipts SET channel_id=#{channelId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid) AND channel_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT actor_ref,request_fingerprint AS fingerprint,channel_id FROM nw_channel_create_receipts WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid)
